Subject: Unexpected overrun — soft uplift request

Hi Olga,

Quick note from Launchly: last week our prod traffic spiked during a feature toggle rollout and we breached our committed quota by ~48% (see attached usage CSV). This is a one-off — we’ve isolated the cause and it won’t recur for routine traffic patterns.

We need two things to close out the month cleanly: 1) a short-window quota uplift for Aug 1–7 so our pipeline remains stable, and 2) a retro credit/true-up path so the spike doesn’t fully land as a regular overrun charge.

Can you share what flexibility Redwood can offer on a staged rebate or a partial credit? If helpful, we can sign an addendum acknowledging the spike and committing to smoothing rules.

Thanks,
Samir
Product Ops — Launchly

Samir — thanks for the heads up and the usage file. Appreciate the quick root-cause note.

Short answer: we can do a temporary uplift window plus a structured rebate but need to align on guardrails so this doesn’t become the default. I’ve outlined two pragmatic options below:

Option A — Short-window uplift + limited retro credit
- Uplift: +60% quota for Aug 1–7.
- Rate: apply existing committed rate for the uplifted volume.
- Retro credit: 40% credit on the incremental overrun above committed for the spike month only.
- Requirement: addendum signed within 72 hours and a short post-mortem (1 pager).

Option B — Tiered uplift + amortized rebate
- Uplift: +30% immediately, with an on-demand temporary burst for up to 24 hours if you need more.
- Retro: amortize the overrun above committed across next two billing cycles as a blended surcharge (25% discount on the overrun portion).
- Requirement: PO or signed addendum; monitoring hook to trigger temporary bursts.

I’m looping in Ben (pricing) and Naomi (customer success credits) to finalize the numbers and paperwork. I’ll attach a draft addendum for legal review.

Next steps: if you say A or B, we’ll send the addendum + DocuSign link and lift the quota within the hour once signed.

—Olga

- Uplift: +55% quota Aug 1–7 (close to your +60% ask; keeps our provisioning buffer sane).
- Retro credit: 35% credit on incremental tokens above committed for July billing period only.
- One-time processing fee: $1,250 to cover provisioning and reporting adjustments (we generally reserve a processing fee for unscheduled spikes).
- DocuSign: addendum attached (redwood-overrun-addendum_v1.pdf).

If Launchly accepts, we’ll:
1) send DocuSign;
2) upon signing, schedule the uplift (we can backdate to Aug 1 for billing fairness for this case);
3) apply the retro credit on the July invoice and show amortized processing fee as a separate line.
